faqs.q: Which language should my website target?
faqs.a: Ideally the ones your customers use. For local services, French plus German covers most searches; Luxembourgish adds authenticity for local trust. English matters for finance and expats. The audit maps your specific customer languages.

Finance keywords are costly to compete for because the rewards are huge. Local service SEO is very reasonable, since competition is thin and each customer is high value. I scope honestly after the audit.

faqs.q: How do cross-border commuters affect my SEO?
faqs.a: They search from France, Belgium or Germany for Luxembourg businesses, so your profiles and pages need to be visible and relevant across borders. Location targeting and language coverage handle this.
Local service terms often move within 2 to 3 months. Finance and high-value B2B keywords are a 6 to 12 month game. I set expectations per keyword cluster, not with blanket promises.

faqs.q: Do you work in French and German?
faqs.a: I plan and brief content in both, and work with native writers where nuance matters. Machine translation is never the strategy.
